name: BountyGuard
summary: Remote MCP server and pre-flight auditor that checks GitHub bounties for on-chain escrow backing and scam signals before an agent starts work.
description: BountyGuard is a pre-flight GitHub bounty auditor and on-chain Proof-of-Escrow verification MCP server for AI coding agents.

Before an agent spends compute solving an open-source bounty issue, BountyGuard inspects maintainer merge history, checks whether funds are locked on-chain on Doomsday Layer-1 or Base Mainnet (wDOOM), and returns a deterministic safety classification.
It is a hosted remote server over streamable HTTP and is also installable from PyPI as a local CLI and stdio MCP server. It is a community listing, not made or endorsed by Anthropic.
notice: Read-only public GitHub issue metadata and on-chain escrow status queries are sent to doomsday.network when using the hosted remote endpoint. No private keys or GitHub credentials are required.

details.label: Transport
details.value: Remote HTTP or local stdio via PyPI

guide.title: Set up
paragraphs: Add it to Claude Code as a remote HTTP server or install the local stdio package from PyPI with pip install bounty-guard. The repository README documents both setups.

guide.title: Download the source
paragraphs: The repository holds the scanner source, MCP server and GitHub Action definition.
